resources.string: Active — Irrigation runs automatically according to moisture and safety conditions
Off — Only manual irrigation can be used
Waiting — Automatic mode will be available when the system is enabled

The moisture limit, irrigation duration, cooldown and restart difference will be applied to all zones. Automatic irrigation and system status will be saved as global settings. You can still change each zone separately later.
Changes have not been saved yet. Saving will apply the irrigation values to all zones.
